subject: Welcome & logistics: candidate access, notetaker, and ASL coverage
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Nguyen <alexandra.nguyen@gmail.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interview scheduling - Redwood Staff SWE (initial)

Hi Alexandra —

Thanks for applying and for speaking with our recruiter last week. We'd like to invite you to an in-person interview loop on campus so the hiring team can meet you and run a coding + system-design session. Do any of the slots below work for you?

- Wed Aug 11, 9:30–12:30 PT (preferred)
- Thu Aug 12, 10:00–1:00 PT
- Fri Aug 13, afternoon (2:00–5:00 PT)

We want to support any accessibility needs you have — please let us know if you need captioning, an ASL interpreter, a quiet room, or anything else. We can also run a hybrid option (candidate remote, interviewers on-site) if that is easier.

Attached: candidate_resume_AlexNguyen.pdf (from your application)

If you confirm a time, we will follow up with an agenda, travel/entry details, and a point of contact on site.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

From: Alexandra Nguyen <alexandra.nguyen@gmail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling - Redwood Staff SWE (initial)

Thanks, Priya —

Wed Aug 11 works best for me (9:30 fine). I do have a hearing-related accessibility need: I prefer live captioning and an ASL interpreter for the system-design portion if possible. I can join remotely if that's simpler for the interpreters, but I'm also happy to come on-site if you can arrange on-site ASL.

Quick note on travel: I'm coming from SF and plan to take BART + shuttle; if there's a lobby check-in pass or escort, that would help.

--
Alexandra Nguyen
alexandra.nguyen@gmail.com | (415) 555-0128

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interview logistics for Alexandra Nguyen — quiet room / notetaker / ASL booking

Team —

Alexandra confirmed Wed Aug 11, 9:30–12:30 PT. She requested live captioning and an ASL interpreter for the system-design block (approx 10:30–11:30). Please see asks below and confirm if you can take ownership:

1) Facility & entry
- Marissa: can you reserve the Quiet Suite (5F, Room QS-3) from 9:00–1:00 so Alexandra has a private place to wait + a quiet backup? I attached site_map_office_5F.pdf.

2) Notetaker / scribe
- Ben: please confirm whether we can assign a notetaker for the interview loop. We prefer someone who can produce a short candidate-friendly summary post-loop (de-identified).

3) ASL interpreter booking
- Soojin: can you reach out to ASL Services (asl@interpret.com) and request an on-site interpreter for 10:30–11:30? If on-site is not available, please book a remote interpreter and ensure the system-design room has a dedicated laptop with gallery view and captions. Candidate notes they are open to remote ASL.

4) Captioning
- Priya: can you arrange live auto-captioning on the Zoom bridge as a backup and include captions in all calendar invites?

5) Access / escort
- Marissa or Ben: confirm a front-desk escort at building entrance at 9:20 and a temporary visitor badge for Alexandra.

Deadline: please reply with confirmations by EOD Tue Aug 3 so we can send Alexandra the final agenda and Zoom link.

Attachments: site_map_office_5F.pdf

Thanks — appreciate everyone's help on the accessibility coordination.

Sofia Ivanova
Hiring Coordinator, People Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Nguyen <alexandra.nguyen@gmail.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Aug 11 interview — Zoom bridge, agenda, and on-site access

Hi Alexandra —

All set for Wed Aug 11, 9:30–12:30 PT. Thank you for the accessibility note; we confirmed the following:

- ASL interpreter booked (on-site pending; remote interpreter confirmed as fallback). Vendor: ASL Services <asl@interpret.com>.
- Quiet Suite reserved (5F, QS-3) from 9:00–13:00.
- Notetaker assigned (Marissa Cole will scribe and produce a short de-identified summary).
- Front-desk escort requested for 9:20.
- Live captions enabled on the Zoom bridge for the whole loop; system-design block will also have dedicated laptop/stream for remote ASL if needed.

Zoom bridge (backup if you prefer remote or for the ASL remote session): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=bridge123
Meeting ID: 987 6543 210
Passcode: R3dW00d

Attached: candidate_agenda_v1.docx, site_map_office_5F.pdf

Agenda highlights (summary):
- 9:30–10:15 Intro + culture fit (onsite meeting room)
- 10:15–11:45 System design + ASL interpreter present (please arrive to the room by 10:10)
- 11:45–12:15 Takeaway / Q&A + wrap-up

If anything changes or you want to switch to fully remote, tell us and we'll update the plan immediately. See you soon and safe travels — let me know your shuttle arrival window so we can coordinate the escort.

Best,
Ben Carter
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
